page.layout: One printed page. Top left: page number 494, then the running head "De Connexione" across the top. Below it, a single table with column headings (Indict., An. Iul., Lit. dom., Nabon., Feriæ., Christi). The table is divided by a rule into two blocks of 15 rows each. The October notes (23 Oct. to 17 Oct.) stand in the Feriæ column. Under the table, at the right, the line "II 1288".

main_text.l: Indict. | An. Iul. | Lit. dom. | Nabon. | Feriæ. | | Christi

page.notes: The table is a chronological table. Its cells are separated by " | ". The October entries (23 Oct. to 17 Oct.) are in the Feriæ column, as printed. The Christi column and the Indiction column are set in a different type, and the right edge of the scan is cut, so the last Christi figures are read from the edge of the image. The final row "II 1288" is printed below the rule at the right and is copied as printed.
